case: November 2011 versus November 2010: opposite signs across identity and financial scopes
data: UCI Online Retail II, canonical product purchase invoices, source GBP

fixed_prior_top_buyers.definition: Top ceil(1% * N) identified buyers by positive product spend during 2010-01-01..2010-10-31; deterministic customer_id tie break; fixed before November 2010

hypotheses.hypothesis: The whole business lost revenue in November
hypotheses.finding: Contradicted by the product ledger scope
hypotheses.limit: Anonymous invoices cannot be assigned to people; identity migration is not established.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Lower items per order accounts for the identified AOV drop
hypotheses.finding: Part of the exact accounting bridge
hypotheses.limit: Product mix, customer mix and quantity discounts can jointly change transaction averages.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Same-SKU paid unit value explains the whole lower pooled unit value
hypotheses.finding: Separate within-SKU and mix contributions; do not label all movement a price cut
hypotheses.limit: Paid unit averages are not list prices and have no promotion/treatment assignment.

hypotheses.hypothesis: A few large buyers generate the identified revenue decline
hypotheses.limit: Excluding these buyers changes the estimand; no claim that they are invalid or causally responsible.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Buyer entry offsets missing November buyers while common buyers also change spend
hypotheses.limit: First observed is not newly acquired; November absence is not permanent churn.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Exact duplicates or return posting reverse the identified sign
hypotheses.finding: Alternative record and financial scopes are measured explicitly
hypotheses.limit: Returns are posting-date credit notes and cannot be linked reliably to original purchases; exact duplicates may be legitimate identical lines.

hypotheses.hypothesis: The November pattern represents the full available calendar comparison
hypotheses.finding: Compare all 11 matched months and pooled windows
hypotheses.limit: Only two historical years and one retailer; December 2011 is incomplete.
